question: STOCK
answer:
Implemented SKU-correct stock handling, cart/checkout stock validation with HTTP 409 conflicts, cancellation restoration and status protection, and zero-stock product availability updates. Added Spec Kit reports for assessment, fix, and verification.

VERIFICATION: {"ran":["./mvnw -pl sm-core,sm-shop -am -DskipTests compile","./mvnw -pl sm-shop -am -Dtest=ShoppingCartAPIIntegrationTest -Dsurefire.failIfNoSpecifiedTests=false test","git diff --check"],"result":"passed","could_not_verify":"Full checkout, cancellation, and v2 product API scenarios were not directly exercised","missing":"Dedicated end-to-end inventory fixtures and regression tests"}

/bin/bash -lc "set -o pipefail
printf '%s\\n' '--- specify files ---'
rg --files .specify 2>/dev/null | sort | head -200
printf '%s\\n' '--- ticket dir ---'
if [ -d .specify/bugs/ticket ]; then find .specify/bugs/ticket -maxdepth 1 -type f -print; fi

if [ -f .specify/extensions.yml ]; then sed -n '1,240p' .specify/extensions.yml; else echo '(none)'; fi
